statement: Establish the single owner of user-plane admission AND wire it at the statement-execution entry: before TRAFFIC_READY, control-plane capability is admitted and ordinary user work is refused with a typed retryable answer carrying the existing lifecycle progress contract, decided in one place rather than inferred from table identity. A composition with no lifecycle authority admits, typed and explicitly, because there is no formation to wait for. Replacing the routing layer's systemTable fail-open with this owner remains a later slice.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

One owner decides user-plane admission. The lifecycle predicate is the exported isTrafficReadySnapshot and the refusal is the exported buildLifecycleReadinessNotReadyError; neither is re-derived here, so no second readiness authority is created. Table identity classifies WHICH capability a statement is, at the boundary; it never decides whether the user plane is open.

No lifecycle authority present (an embedded engine with no cluster to form) admits; an authority present but yielding no readable snapshot REFUSES user work. These are distinct typed outcomes, because collapsing them would let a wiring regression read as "no cluster" and silently admit everything.
Control-plane capability is admitted before TRAFFIC_READY whether readiness is not-yet-ready or unreadable, because refusing the work that produces readiness would deadlock formation.
A refusal carries the readiness owner’s own retryAfterMs, progress contract, wake source and blocking dependency; this Quest invents no retry budget and no new error taxonomy.

The composition resolver must read a key the real seed and joiner runtime owners actually expose, and the provider must be lazy because readiness is wired after the engine is built. A gate that runs but can never refuse is not a gate; this is pinned by a receipt because it is invisible to a passing suite.

The admission owner mints no lifecycle phase, publishes nothing, and derives nothing from nodes.status, publication counts, or coverage; its decision is frozen and carries exactly admitted, reasonCode and lifecycleReadiness.
Proof is a deterministic node:test witness, with existing-readiness-predicates-unchanged as the control that must stay green; every guard is mutation-verified and no cloud run is part of the proof.
